notes: 02: fetchPageDetails/extractPageDetails collect only title+description; no favicon or preview image collected or stored. 03: title/description editable after save (edit-details), and manually enterable only in the metadata-unavailable fallback; no edit-before-save step for auto-collected details. 04: PATCH edits title/description/note/tags but url is not editable. 05: no DELETE endpoint or delete UI/bulk delete anywhere. 07: cards show title/description/tags but no favicon (initials placeholder only). 12: matches() searches title/description/note but not url. 14: no #tag search syntax. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. 16: no quoted-phrase exact-match parsing. 20: no multi-select or bulk actions. 21: no whole-collection/filter-scoped bulk action. 22: fixed createdAt-desc ordering only; no user sort control or other sort keys. 23: notes stored and shown as escaped plain text, not rendered markdown. 24: no HTML/PDF snapshot. 25: no Internet Archive integration. 26/27/28: no archived flag, archive action, delete-vs-archive distinction, or archive view in code. 29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. 30: no Netscape HTML import. 31: no export. 32: no user/display settings (sort, displayed items, font size).
